To delete a local branch, run git branch -d name, or -D to force one that is not merged.

To delete a remote branch, run git push origin --delete name. To rename locally, use git branch -m old new. There is no remote rename: push the new name, delete the old one, then reset tracking with git push -u origin new.

Git Delete Branch and Rename Branch: Local and Remote, One Reference

Quick thread 🧵
To delete a local branch, run git branch -d name, or -D to force one that is not merged.
To delete a remote branch, run git push origin --delete name.
To rename locally, use git branch -m old new.
There is no remote rename: push the new name, delete the old one, then reset tracking with git push -u origin new.
